status: Original OpenRC design (step 15): a twin-boom EPO pusher in the 1.8 m long-range FPV class (Skyhunter 1800 class). Our own parametric outline from the class's published headline figures (span, wing area, motor, propeller); no kit drawing, CAD, photograph or livery was used.
class_reference: Retail listings of the SonicModell/ZOHD Skyhunter 1800 (checked 2026-11-16): span 1800 mm, length 1400 mm, main wing area 36 dm2, recommended flying weight 3 kg, 2820 920 Kv motor, 11x7 propeller, 60 A ESC, three 12 g servos (getfpv.com, motionrc.com, unmannedtechshop.co.uk). Used as class figures only.
frame: LE frame [x_aft, y_right, z_up] in metres; D0 = wing root leading edge on the symmetry plane at the wing chord plane

pod.stations_note: [x, half width, bottom z, top z]; the wing sits on the pod's flat top
